purpose: Machine-readable control for Gil Marer / Aweswell's direct actor-specific criminal allegations concerning the five named private actors, the 7 June 2018 Sun Park entry, CAM creditor control, shadow or de facto administration, Insolvency Administrator affirmative commission, enablement, approval, ratification and omissions, and judicial affirmative acts and omissions including alleged funded-exit sabotage. It preserves the attribution at full strength while classifying evidence, contrary material, unresolved proof, adjudication and source literal separately.

canonical_private_actor_perimeter_202608.control_rule: Five private actors are named individually. The Insolvency Administrator and judge remain separate institutional nodes, not sixth and seventh private actors.
canonical_private_actor_perimeter_202608.direct_shadow_administration_allegation: Gil Marer directly alleges that the five named private actors formed or used a shadow or de facto administration and allegedly concealed parallel-control architecture spanning Community authority, debt and voting, access and keys, security, maintenance, works and valuation, insolvency strategy, the funded rescue, operation, income and project benefit.

direct_allegation.es: Gil Marer alega directamente que Aweswell cumplió o podía cumplir todas las condiciones de promotor, prestatario o contraparte bajo su control; que las dependencias operativas bloqueadas fueron la preservación y entrega del paquete escalonado de garantías y colateral, la autorización judicial y la certificación exacta de deuda por la Administración Concursal; y que la cadena de cinco actores, Administrador Concursal y juez controló, desplazó o socavó esas dependencias mediante un mecanismo coercitivo alegado de control paralelo o acreedor en posesión que obstruyó la redención y refinanciación.
direct_allegation.en: Gil Marer directly alleges that Aweswell performed or could perform all sponsor-side, borrower-side or counterparty conditions within its control; that the operative blocked dependencies were preservation and delivery of the staged security and collateral package, judicial authority and an accurate Insolvency Administrator debt certificate; and that the five-actor, Administrator and judge chain controlled, displaced or undermined those dependencies through an alleged coercive parallel-control or lender-in-possession mechanism obstructing redemption and refinancing.

court_administrator_and_collateral_depen.gil_position: Gil alleges that operative obstruction concerned preservation and delivery of collateral and outputs controlled or undermined across the five-actor, Administrator and judicial chain.

ben_oldman.documented: The current canonical source records a separate later Binding Term Sheet dated 1 August 2018 and signed by the lender-side signatory, Aweswell and Matkator, with a later signed extension and staged pre-exit and post-exit security.
ben_oldman.limits: It remained a conditional term sheet with expiry mechanics, not a definitive facility agreement, proof that every condition was satisfied or waived, closing, or drawdown.

creditor_in_possession.test: Whether the creditor crossed from enforcement and collateral protection into actual possession, direction, management, use or appropriation before formal adjudication.

functional_frameworks.accounting_start: The first proven date of material use, access, decision-making power or economic benefit, not merely the later adjudication or registration date.
functional_frameworks.claimant_allocation: LPB or its estate, Aweswell, CEXP, Matkator, Pink, individual owners and other claimants must be allocated separate heads without double recovery.

statutory_tests.boundary: Each act is classified under the criminal law in force when committed, subject to retroactive application of a later provision more favourable to the accused; current consolidated wording is not projected backwards automatically.
Commission by omission requires a specific legal or contractual duty, or prior risk-creating conduct, making non-prevention legally equivalent to action.
Negligent conduct is criminal only where the Criminal Code expressly provides for punishment of negligence.
Corporate or representative capacity does not replace proof of the natural person's act, role and mental element.
Any property-disposition or authority representation theory requires the exact act, insufficient authority, reliance, loss and intent.
Any disloyal-administration theory requires powers over another's assets, excess or abuse and patrimonial loss.
The insolvency-administrator provision does not criminalise every breach; an underlying malversation offence, affected estate or creditor interests and the required intent must be proved.
Judicial prevarication requires a knowingly unjust judicial sentence or resolution.
The negligent judicial form requires gross negligence or inexcusable ignorance and a manifestly unjust sentence or resolution.
Refusal to judge must be identified and distinguished from an adverse decision or procedural disposition.
Malicious delay requires delay caused to obtain an illegitimate purpose.
Any arbitrary-self-help theory requires assertion of one's own right outside lawful channels with violence, intimidation or force against things; it is an investigative issue, not a conclusion.
A creditor may not appropriate or dispose of pledged or mortgaged property merely by virtue of the security.
Mortgage creates direct subjection of the asset to the secured obligation; it does not itself transfer possession.
Mortgage-law subjection of the asset is not automatic possession, management or whole-hotel title.
Interim administration or possession follows a judicial procedural route; no corresponding CAM instrument is located in the reviewed corpus.
The effect of provisional dismissal requires the actual order, facts, persons, completed investigation, finality and any genuinely new indicia; the label alone is insufficient.
De facto administrator status turns on actual administrator functions or habitual instruction of formal administrators, not creditor influence alone.

legal_boundaries.judicial_shortcut_prohibited: An adverse or incomplete judicial ruling, a failure to grant a requested remedy, or an institutional receipt is not by itself proof of judicial prevarication.

judicial_corrective_or_contrary_acts_pre: partially favourable aspects of the 2021 order
contrary_record.scope_rule: Preserve the procedural outcome prominently and compare its exact subject, actors and evidence with the expanded later record; do not recast it as either a conviction, universal merits declaration or reason to suppress the direct attribution.
